name: B10-0231/2025 (ESN) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Cameroon to treat jailed journalists better, including giving them access to medical care. It wants the murder case of journalist Martinez Zogo handled openly and fairly, with those responsible brought to justice. It also condemns Boko Haram attacks and supports Cameroon's fight against them. Separately, it criticises how the European Union gives democracy aid to Cameroon, saying the current approach ignores local realities. The text is a statement of the Parliament's views and requests; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament asks Cameroon for medical care for jailed journalists and a fair Zogo murder case.
- The journalists named, Cameroon's authorities, and the EU aid programmes are affected.
- The resolution is sent to EU bodies and Cameroon's leaders; no law changes.
